structured.answer: From what I understood, a keren hishtalmut is savings where the employer puts in 7.5% of the salary and I put in 2.5%, and after 6 years you can take everything out without tax (it says 3 years for someone past retirement age), so with the employer's money it seems worth having. But it isn't a deposit: its value goes up and down and the state doesn't guarantee it, so before I choose a track I'll ask you or the bank.
